scenario: AITA for lying to my bf and letting him believe his ex cheated on him? | I know this sounds really bad but just hear me out. it's been eating me up inside so I'd like some feedback. I had a crush on him since basically freshman year but I knew he was dating this girl. I know there's nothing to gain by telling the truth now. He's so much happier than before and he has no regrets about his exgf anymore. So, am I the asshole for lying and keeping up with the lie?
